1.consolidated_definition: Cuando se cosechaba la mata entera de tabaco se amarraban varias para colgarlas a secar y luego ponerlas en blandón. A cada grupo de esas matas se le llamaba matraco. Actualmente el tabaco se va cosechando por hojas según estas van madurando. Al tabaco guindado se le llamaba horcado (ahorcado.).
1.en_consolidated_definition: When the entire tobacco plant was harvested, several were tied together to dry and then placed in a blandón. Each group of these plants was called a matraco. Currently, tobacco is harvested by leaves as they mature. The hung tobacco was also known as horcado (hanged).
